text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Only now do I realize what I should've done differently. This, too, is due to my inexperience.
choice_data_list: Experience is key, but you did the best with what you have now.
Learn what you can from today and win your next race!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It is as you say… I may have lost, but I raced with all I had.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will accept my shortcomings and use the experience as fuel to overcome future challenges.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu! There's only one thing left to do now, and that is to achieve victory.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And if I am to do that, I must identify where my weaknesses lie.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'd like for today's review session to begin as soon as possible.
